included: A runtime subset of the official archify/ core: CLI, schemas, renderers, viewer assets, references, runtime scripts, migrations, delta, recipes, brand metadata, bundled explainer dependencies and thirteen doctor proof fixtures. Upstream skill instructions, tests and generated example output artifacts are omitted.
updatePolicy: Update deliberately from the upstream repository; keep the vendored CLI offline by setting ARCHIFY_UPDATE_CHECK_DISABLED=1.
